author: blu
body: Proves two-colour splash decks. A genome whose splash colour differs from its main colour builds a mostly-main deck with a handful of off-colour answers and a mana base that can cast them. A Blue Control deck splashing White should contain white spells (Swords to Plowshares, Wrath of God) and a White/Blue dual land (Tundra), while a mono-blue version of the same genome contains no white spells. Both decks stay at 60 cards.
